digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and unified reconciler architecture (RP-02 through RP-06)
propositions: RP-02 requires ordered exact-match retirement recovery at explicit live-operation boundary with no-op repeats and safety-abort ambiguity
RP-03 depends on RP-02 coherent state and uses scoped finite-pass fuse (3 consecutive exhausted outcomes, 2+ tickets) with maximum 3 physical invocations and 15s cumulative sleep per atomic operation
RP-04 supplies centralized operation authority with explicit CLI > environment > project > user > default precedence and separated secret/provider boundary
RP-05 normalizes all 21 visible advanced verbs onto side-effect-free package-data help before operation-snapshot composition, with compatibility shims naming replacements

RP-06 applies effective applicability to project criteria, enforces non-empty applies_to globs, uses Option-B failure policy (preserve results, skip dependents, unsigned INDETERMINATE), and adds explicit review-plan --retry with fresh budget and lineage trace persistence
